mentions.description: Handcrafted walnut multi-guitar stands. The author made one for their father and plans to get professional product photos taken and build an ecommerce website to sell the stands.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made my pops a walnut multi-guitar stand a couple months ago and I’d like to get some nice pics done and make one of those eCommerce web site things to sell them.
